capabilities: Record income and expense entries per account note with categories, payers, and tags
Track debts, credits with payment schedules, and deposits with interest accruals
View statistics and charts for balance, credit burden, and category spending
Import and export account data as CSV, JSON, or XML with field mapping
Attach photo receipts and documents to records
extras: Account data is stored as JSON files under .obsidian/plugins/finance-manager/accounts/{accountId}/, not in the notes themselves. Default language is Russian with English also supported; installable manually or via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record and analyze personal finances (accounts, debts, credits, deposits) inside notes.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT plugin (Beta Reviewers Auto-update Tool)

summary: Personal finance tracker that turns each note into an account for income, expenses, debts, credits, and deposits, with charts and CSV/JSON/XML import-export.
